romanizationKeyboard.comment: Section header for the romanization keyboard layouts (host tab + IME layout overlay).

taigiPhonetic.comment: Section header for the Taiwanese phonetic (TPS) keyboard layouts.

standardLayout.comment: Layout name: the standard QWERTY-style romanization layout (Lohankha).

phahTaigiLayout.comment: Layout name: the PhahTaigi romanization layout.

tpsLayout.comment: Layout name: the Taiwanese Phonetic Symbols (方音符號) keyboard.

moe1Layout.comment: Layout name: the MOE input-method keyboard, variant 1.

moe2Layout.comment: Layout name: the MOE input-method keyboard, variant 2.

comingSoon.comment: Placeholder badge for a layout that is not yet available. iOS-only: shown in the iOS layout-selection overlay (LayoutSelectionOverlay.swift); Android has no such placeholder.
